title: Realmz Providence Canonical Project
description: The versioned, persisted Providence project contract. The generated seam owns the top-level inventory plus migrated source, scenario-startup, map, tile-attribute, custom-landlook, record, encounter, and rule-override DTO families; remaining nested domain DTO schemas are incremental work.

actionCategory.description: The normalized Rust compiler/runtime vocabulary. Editor action-category labels remain an open author-facing string and are not silently coerced to this enum.

category.description: Open editor-facing label in TypeScript; normalized through ActionCategory at the Rust boundary.

canonicalObject.description: A canonical nested DTO whose field-level schema will be generated in a later slice.

origin.description: Authored projects compile from canonical data; imported projects may consult the compatibility annex.

rawSourcesDir.description: Compatibility-annex location. It is empty for normal authored projects.
